description_en: Retrieves a list of normalization schemas
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-normalization-schemas --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --normalization-schema-type entity --normalization-category-id NETWORK_CATEGORY --normalization-security-domain-id NETWORK_AND_WEB_SECURITY --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --normalization-field-source normalized --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNormalizationSchemas

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: the asset is in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: the asset is outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator switches to when viewing as another member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The normalization schema type. Valid values:
log: log.
entity: entity
parameters.help_zh:
标准化结构类型。取值：
log：日志。
entity：实体
parameters.name: normalization_schema_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the normalization rule category
parameters.name: normalization_category_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no more results exist. If more results exist, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The field source filter. Valid values: normalized / native
parameters.help_zh: 字段来源筛选，可选值：normalized / native
parameters.name: normalization_field_source
